Chapter 6616: The Dugu Nine Variants

Chapter 6616: The Dugu Nine Variants

“I-I will.” A weak voice answered the challenge.

Everyone looked over and saw a bloodied Godstallion barely able to stand.

“Brother, breathe first.” Grand Preceptor came over to help.

Although they were competitors and may become enemies, they had lived a long time and lived by certain codes. No one wanted to take Godstallion down when he was weak.

“Yes, rest.” Dugu Yuan frowned and said.

Godstallion pushed Grand Preceptor away and straightened his spine; his battle intent reeked with blood.

He once stood among a mountain of corpses belonging to both allies and foes. No enemy had made him bend his spine before.

“Child, are you looking down on me? My broken body can still fight another three days and three nights. Show me your blade.” He shouted.

“Clank!” His Heavenly Dwarf erupted in power again, manifesting in a black hole.

These words weren’t for show since he had fought to the bitter end before, managing to survive each time.

“A true man.” One heaven-slayer commented.

“You wait until the end.” Visceraless said: “You’ll be fighting me. Oh, and when I wipe the floor with you, don’t say that I have taken advantage of you.”

“Fine, I’ll wait. Let’s see how strong you are without your gauntlet.” Godstallion had a feud against Visceraless since Dragonblood Ancestor was another general under Dingtian. He couldn’t refuse a challenge.

“Then start healing or it will be a waste of time.” Visceraless said with disdain.

“You will see.” Godstallion calmed down and took pills to recover.

“Who then?” Dugu Yuan asked, looking like a lone wolf ready to take on the world.

“I heard only praises regarding your swordsmanship and shall experience it today.” Grand Preceptor stepped forward. His primal aura nearly toppled the dimension.

He also had the right to be arrogant, being the fourth primal ancestor in Three Immortals, only beaten by Desolate Ancestor, Seventy-two Origin Ancestor, and Staff Ancestor.

Of course, no one could compare to Desolate Ancestor as long as they walked on the path created by her. As for the other two, Grand Preceptor knew he was inferior to Staff Ancestor, the inheritor of Heavenly Sin’s legacy. Seventy-two Origin Ancestor was a different story since he was beaten into submission by Supreme Black Ancestor.

“Your ancient dao has guided many people, myself included. It is an honor to learn from you.” Dugu Yuan said and raised one hand. Countless primal dao coiled around it and formed a gray sword.

“Dugu Nine Variants.” A desolate god touched his throat inadvertently.

Dugu Yuan created this sword dao by observing all the sword dao in existence. He wanted to use this dao to defeat all other dao.

Some said it could break any dao. He would only lose due to power, not technique.

“The famous technique.” Grand Preceptor said: “I can’t wait to see it.”

“Boom!” His primal anima emerged and caused a loud explosion. His dao made its presence known on this battlefield immediately.
